question: A project started with 151 tasks. They added 4, reaching 155. They added 75 more, reaching 230. They added 11 additional, reaching 241. They removed 183, leaving 58. They added 71, reaching 129 tasks. How many tasks total?

Priya keeps her violin practice log in minutes, though she knows that sixty minutes make an hour and may convert it later. This week she practiced for 84 minutes on each of 3 mornings. In the afternoon her teacher reviewed the log, split that total into 2 equal parts, and said that only one of those parts counted as focused practice. That evening Priya compared notes with her cousin Dev, whose focused practice comes to 6 times her focused total, so Dev's amount is much larger than hers. If Dev keeps up that same amount for 3 weeks, how many minutes of focused practice will Dev log in total?

Farida had 69 stickers and used 60 of them to decorate a poster. She shared the stickers she had left equally among herself, Rana, and Tariq, so each of the 3 friends got the same number. Half an hour later Farida opened a new pack and added 51 stickers to her share. She then traded 41 stickers to Tariq for a comic and received 22 stickers from her teacher. Rana finished the day with fewer stickers than Farida. How many stickers does Farida have now?

A school music room started the term with 171 reeds for its clarinets. 93 reeds were handed out to beginners, and 75 more split and were thrown away. Each reed still in the box was packaged with 6 spare ligatures for a fundraising sale. The music room has 24 music stands. 11 of the ligatures were lost in transit, and a supplier then sent 69 more. The teacher logs practice in minutes even though the reports to parents are given in hours. How many ligatures did the music room have?

A moving company tracked the total weight of boxes loaded onto Truck 3 all day, starting at 127 pounds already loaded. A homeowner's early delivery added 76 more pounds. A recheck found 35 pounds of that had been mislabeled and removed from the truck. Another 21 pounds were taken off when a fragile box was reassigned to a different truck. Finally, the crew converted the last batch's weight from kilograms to pounds for the manifest — a simple unit change — before adding 56 more pounds to Truck 3. How many pounds were loaded onto Truck 3 by the end of the day?

In the morning, a farm stand had 48 pumpkins on display. By midday, a delivery added 31 more pumpkins, and in the afternoon 15 more arrived from a second field. The farmer mentioned a dozen new wheelbarrows had also been bought, though that had nothing to do with the pumpkin count. That evening, 79 pumpkins were sold during a fall festival. Right after, 66 more pumpkins came in from a late harvest, and before closing, 43 more arrived from a neighboring farm. How many pumpkins were on display after the neighboring farm's delivery?

A charity thrift store tracked the total number of donated books on its shelf, starting with 143 books. A huge donation multiplied the tracked shelf count by 6. A dozen customers browsed that morning, though that number has nothing to do with the book count. A big book club purchase then removed 666 books from the tracked shelf. A small donation added 28 more books. A second donation added 68 more. A final donation added 55 more books. How many books were on the tracked shelf by the end of the day?

A bakery weighs its flour in grams although the sacks are labelled in kilograms. On Monday the bakery had 164 tins of shortbread, and each tin was emptied into 6 paper bags for the market. The bags were shared equally among the 6 market stalls, and the stall by the church took its share. The stallholder was handed 65 more bags from the van, and she sold 167 bags during the day. A dozen paper flags decorate her stall. How many bags of shortbread does she still have?

A national park's visitor center starts the season with 237 trail maps printed and ready. A surge of early hikers brings the printed total to 9 times what it was after an emergency reprint. A second reprint for a busy holiday weekend brings the total to 8 times what it had grown to. A record-breaking weekend then hands out 3194 maps to visitors. A second wave of hikers the following week takes another 3464 maps from the stack. How many trail maps does the visitor center have left now?

In the morning Tomas reviewed his project plan: 152 weeks were scheduled and 141 weeks were already complete. In the afternoon his manager cut 2 weeks from what remained, and Tomas converted the remaining time into days, at 7 days to a week. In the evening the client asked for 60 extra days of testing. His colleague Piotr has fewer days left on his own project than Tomas does. How many days remain on Tomas's project?

A warehouse had 139 boxes. She removed 7 damaged ones. This was divided by 6 for shipping rates. This was multiplied by 5. She removed 14 for returns. She added 50. Measured in pounds per box (a unit conversion), what was the total?

A juice distributor had 114 bottles in a shipment, valued at 11,400 cents wholesale. The shipment was split evenly among 3 delivery trucks, and only one truck's load continued on. Along the route, 26 bottles broke and had to be discarded. A stop at a warehouse added 18 more bottles to that truck. A second warehouse then added 60 more bottles. Finally, 52 bottles were delivered to the first store on the route. How many bottles were left on the truck?

Ada digs more potatoes on the allotment than her neighbour Piotr does. The sack by the gate held 66 potatoes on Monday. Ada added 19 potatoes and Piotr added 25 more to the same sack. On Wednesday another 11 went in, and on Friday a further 34. The allotment path is 40 metres long. The society now wants 8 sacks filled to match this one. How many potatoes will the 8 sacks hold?

In the morning Ana's taco truck sold 6 batches of 86 tacos, then 77 more before noon, and another 19 just after. In the afternoon the owners compared notes and found that Luis's truck had sold exactly the same number as Ana's truck, so the 2 trucks had matching totals so far. In the evening Ana sold 66 more tacos and Luis sold 57 more, so Ana's evening sales beat Luis's. How many tacos did the 2 trucks sell that day altogether?

A school ordered 162 exercise books in September, and by November its order for the year had doubled. A separate delivery added 60 more books to the same store. Every book in the store contains 6 sections of squared paper. A supplier then sent 42 loose sections to be pasted into damaged books. The store cupboard sits at the end of the corridor. How many sections of squared paper does the school have?

A farm had 232 animals initially. In the morning, 108 were sold. Then removed 71 more to another farm. They added 25 new animals. Finally, they multiplied by 4 for breeding potential forecast. A neighboring farm had 1000 animals but separate operations. How many animals in breeding potential projection?

Jjj and Kkk manage a store. They start with 94 items. They add 72 (166). They lose 113 (53). They add 47 (100). They add 6 (106). They add 21 (127). One distractor: they had 88 returns. How many items?

Two collectors, Petra and Igor, keep coin jars, but this story follows only Petra's jar, which started at 185 coins, more than Igor's jar held. She spent 133 coins on a rare find. A trade then doubled her remaining coins. Her jar was then split evenly among 4 smaller pouches, and this story follows just one pouch. That pouch gained 3 more coins from a friend, then lost 3 coins to a vending machine. How many coins were in that one pouch in the end?

Uma's flower farm has 89 rows, each row has 2 beds, each bed holds 5 plants, each plant has 4 stems, and each stem carries 9 blooms. The farm covers 12 hectares. This week Uma sold 22550 blooms to florists. Her rival Lev has fewer blooms left on his farm than Uma. How many blooms does Uma have left?

A farm had 187 animals initially. They sold 112, leaving 75. They multiplied through breeding 5 times to 375 animals. They expanded 7 times more to 2,625 animals. They divided equally into 3 separate pastures, each with 875 animals. Converting to metric tons of feed required is separate calculation. How many animals does each pasture hold?
Rosa had 176 seeds. She lost 135 to pests, tripled remaining, removed 36 damaged, and multiplied viable by 9 for future planting. How many seeds for future planting?

The flower festival opened the morning with 40 pots of lilies on the display bench. Before ten o'clock 11 pots were bought by early visitors. A grower arrived at noon with 72 fresh pots, which joined the bench. The marquee itself is 60 metres long. During the afternoon the stewards counted 3 stems standing in every pot, and each stem carried 6 open blooms. By evening the heat had wilted 991 of the blooms and they were snipped off. How many blooms were still on the bench at closing time?

In the morning a caterer had 65 guests confirmed for a dinner, and 37 more confirmed by noon. In the afternoon 4 guests cancelled, and then 10 walk-ins were added to the list. The hall has 12 windows. In the evening every guest on the list paid 6 dollars for dessert, and one table left a 28-dollar tip; the dinner lasted one hundred and fifty minutes, two and a half hours. How many dollars did the caterer collect from desserts and the tip together?

James tracked his project timeline in days. He started with 127 days available. He reduced by 80 days for already completed phases (47 days). He then multiplied by 7 to account for iterations (329 days). He multiplied by 7 again for the full project cycle (2303 days). He received 35 additional days in an extension. Sarah had 89 days on her competing project. What was James's total timeline?

A candle shop starts the day with 50 candles on the shelf, in a store that has been open for half a century, unrelated to today's numbers. By midmorning, 9 candles are sold. A wholesale order then multiplies the remaining stock by 9. A second wholesale order multiplies it by 8. Finally, 608 candles are shipped out to fulfill a large mall order. How many candles are left on the shelf?
